# orion sync

Update pull request items from GitHub

```sh
orion sync [options]
```

| Argument     | Description                                                             |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--discover` | Add your open pull requests that aren't on the canvas to an Inbox group |
| `--dry-run`  | Show what would change without writing                                  |
| `--json`     | Print JSON                                                              |
